note: digital-me-os docs-truth sweep (motus-facts-sweep). packageJsonPath points at the bundle script because the published npm name (`digital-me`) is stamped there at publish time — the workspace package stays @digital-me/cli and the root manifest is digital-me-os, so neither is the published-name ground truth (see .github/workflows/publish-cli.yml). retiredClaims (2026-09-21) registers the pre-#123 'openclaw is the hub / mandatory' narrative and scans the docs-site sources + ARCHITECTURE too (retiredSurfaces), so a regression of that story blocks the nightly instead of drifting for months; those pages stay out of `surfaces` because their illustrative `plugins/`-style tokens would false-flag the path rule.

retiredClaims.reason: brain-host (packages/services/brain-host) is the hub since digital-me #123 (2026-09-21): retriever + brain-orchestrator on /tools/invoke, owns brain.db + the tick. openclaw is one optional runtime.
the openclaw prerequisite gate was lifted in digital-me #123; setup installs brain-host itself and --skip-openclaw-check is a deprecated no-op.

the brain's MCP server is `digital-me-brain` (BRAIN_MCP_SERVER_NAME in @digital-me/contracts); `openclaw-brain` is only a legacy alias that install removes. Mentioning it as the old name is fine; presenting it as the current one is not.
